Subject: Q4 forecast alignment and stage updates

Hi Ava / Ben,

Hope you both are well. Finance at Acme is finalizing numbers for our Q4 close and asked me to confirm the committed dates and stage status for our Redwood engagement. A quick request: can you send a red/yellow/green breakdown of the top 6 deals tied to this forecast and any immediate save-plan actions by EOD Friday (2026-12-04)?

Specifically we need:
- Confirmed close date or next milestone for each deal
- Any outstanding procurement or legal blockers
- Clear owner for the next action (e.g., contract countersign, SOW approval, PO submission)

Appreciate a concise list — Finance will use it to lock the forecast.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Sr. FP&A Manager, Acme, Inc.

Maria — thanks for the clear ask. Below is a compact red/yellow/green break and an immediate save plan for the six deals contributing to the Q4 commit bucket. I attached a one-sheet (Q4_commit_list.xlsx) with per-deal notes and owner tags.

Top 6 (red/yellow/green + save action):

1) ACME Analytics (Green) — On track
   - Close target: 2026-12-09
   - Next action: Final countersign (Legal) — Owner: ACME Legal / Redwood AE (Ben)
   - Notes: Pricing agreed; awaiting signature.

2) ClearWave Migration (Yellow) — Conditional
   - Close target: 2026-12-15
   - Next action: Procurement to confirm PO (waiting on PO release) — Owner: ACME IT (Tom) / Ben to nudge
   - Save plan: Offer 2-week pilot extension and invoice milestone shift to reduce procurement friction.

3) Orion Labs (Red) — High risk
   - Close target: 2026-12-31 (uncommitted)
   - Next action: Legal redlines outstanding; security questionnaire incomplete — Owner: ACME Security / Laura to escalate
   - Save plan: Escalate to ACME SOC contact and provide SOC2 evidence bundle; propose phased rollout to de-risk.

4) Nimbus Retail (Yellow)
   - Close target: 2026-12-20
   - Next action: Pricing approval from procurement — Owner: Ben
   - Save plan: Lock pricing via a 30-day price-protection memo and hold slot in Dedicated capacity.

5) AtlasBio (Green)
   - Close target: 2026-12-08
   - Next action: Final PO submission — Owner: ACME Procurement

6) Helios Media (Red)
   - Close target: 2027-01-10 (rolled)
   - Next action: Technical POC response time concerns — Owner: Redwood Solutions Eng (Ava)
   - Save plan: Offer dedicated technical office hours and an SLA appendix for initial production window.

Quick asks for Acme Finance: if you need us to mark any of the Yellows as partial-commit (e.g., 50% of value) or move Red to backlog for the locked forecast, confirm the policy by Friday so Ben and I can adjust HubSpot and the attached spreadsheet.

Attachments: Q4_commit_list.xlsx (spreadsheet) — per-deal notes and owner cells.

Next steps (proposed):
- Ben to chase procurement POs for ClearWave + Nimbus by EOD Thu (3 Dec).
- Laura to escalate Orion legal/security to ACME SOC contact and loop CustOps.
- Ava to schedule Helios technical office hours (this week).
- Maria / Acme Finance to confirm partial-commit rules by Fri EOD.

Thanks — I’ll update the drive link once Ben confirms PO statuses.

Best,
Ava Chen
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
